segments.title: Tallest mountain? Not Everest
segments.say: Quick quiz. The tallest mountain on Earth is not Everest.

segments.title: Pick one
segments.say: Measured from base to peak, is it K2, Mauna Kea, or Kilimanjaro? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Most of it is underwater
segments.say: About six thousand meters of it is under the ocean.

segments.title: Over 10,000 m base to top
segments.say: Base to peak, it's about ten thousand two hundred meters. Taller than Everest above sea level.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Should Mauna Kea get the title? Comment below, and follow Nexora.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
